Asha: Quick FYI - scheduling a regional soft-tilt for eu-west at 21:30 UTC to roll router affinity + small auth cache tweak. Need quick rollback gates and who will run smoke.
Ben: Proposal: 15% steps every 4m, start with 10% warm for 10m. Abort if p95 > baseline+250ms for 5m OR 5xx rate > 1% over 3m.
Kai: I'm oncall. Also add: session-affinity misroute > 0.4% over 10k sessions should abort. I'll watch dashboards and run rollback if needed.
Asha: Pushed config to ops:
```
soft_tilt:
  steps: [10,15,15,20,20,20]
  cadence_mins: 4
  warmup_min: 10
  abort_triggers:
    p95_delta_ms: 250
    err_5xx_pct: 1.0
    misroute_pct: 0.4
```
